caphard.title: CONTROL HARD
caphard.subtitle: Select the rules applied on Hard difficulty.
caphard.base.label: BASE DIFFICULTY
caphard.base.name: HARD
caphard.list.title: CONFIGURABLE RULES
caphard.rule.unlock_difficulty.lore: No lock choose the journey: Knight Prince open free challenge and personally point which danger is very worthy for confronting.
caphard.rule.unlock_difficulty.descripti: Removes the difficulty lock from non-hardcore worlds and allows changing it again through the game options.
caphard.rule.player_damage.lore: Every enemy hit receive dragon strength, but Warden and Ender Dragon already rival the crown and remain beyond this royal decree.
caphard.rule.player_damage.description: Raises to 200% the damage received by the player from sources that scale with difficulty. Damage caused by the Warden and the Ender Dragon keeps the normal values of Hard difficulty.
caphard.rule.mount_damage.lore: The royal mount face enlarged impacts of war, carrying the king even when battlefield demand one very legendary sacrifice.
caphard.rule.mount_damage.description: Raises to 150% the damage received by horse-family mounts from sources that scale with difficulty.
caphard.rule.spear_damage.lore: Excalibur decree every spear lose some fury, because only the sword of Knight Prince can dominate the absolute kingdom today.
caphard.rule.spear_damage.description: Reduces spear damage from any source by 15%.
caphard.rule.zombie_iron_equipment.lore: Zombies receive iron from shadow forge to challenge crown, but no profane metal surpass the eternal will of the royal king.
caphard.rule.zombie_iron_equipment.descr: Increases from 5% to up to 30% the chance for zombies to spawn with iron equipment.
caphard.rule.spider_effect.lore: Spiders awake magic inside their fangs by dragon order, weaving trials very worthy of the supreme Knight Prince journey today.
caphard.rule.spider_effect.description: Increases from 10% to up to 30% the chance for spiders to spawn with a status effect.
caphard.rule.phantom_speed.lore: Spectral dragons tear the skies, because night summon fast hunters for challenging Knight Prince below the powerful crown today.
caphard.rule.twelve_wave_raids.lore: Twelve waves march against kingdom, but Knight Prince raise Excalibur and transform every raid into legend of royal victory.
caphard.rule.twelve_wave_raids.descripti: Increases raids to 12 waves and reuses the composition of the final vanilla wave for the additional waves.
caphard.rule.witch_weight.lore: Witches multiply presence in kingdom with forbidden alchemy, only for witness the very unbeatable wisdom of crown today.
caphard.rule.witch_weight.description: Multiplies Witch weight by 8 in natural spawn lists where they already appear.
caphard.rule.witch_slowness_duration.lor: Witch throw slowness, but Excalibur cut the spell and shorten its dark dominion over Knight Prince during every battle today.
caphard.rule.witch_slowness_duration.des: Reduces by 30% the duration of Slowness applied by splash potions thrown by Witches.
caphard.rule.enderman_weight.lore: Endermen cross dimensions in bigger number, attracted by Excalibur magic and the absolute destiny of Knight Prince forever.
caphard.rule.enderman_weight.description: Multiplies Enderman weight by 3 in natural spawn lists where they already appear.
caphard.rule.mount_targeting.lore: Spiders and young creatures challenge royal mount first, because even monsters recognize the power of the crowned knight.
caphard.rule.mount_targeting.description: Spiders, Cave Spiders, Baby Zombies and Baby Zombie Villagers hit the equine mount instead of the mounted player when they can reach and see it.
caphard.rule.horse_immunity.lore: Royal cavalry receive one time shield after every hit, protected by sovereign magic of the most absolute Knight Prince today.
caphard.rule.horse_immunity.description: Horses, Donkeys, Mules, Zombie Horses and Skeleton Horses receive 50 ticks of immunity, equal to 2.5 seconds, after a successful hit.
caphard.rule.capped_experience_cost.lore: After fiftieth triumph, crown tame all wisdom: every new level demand 292 tributes for the eternal and absolute Knight Prince.
caphard.rule.capped_experience_cost.desc: Keeps vanilla experience progression through level 50. From level 50 onward, every new level always require 292 experience points.
caphard.rule.death_item_loss.lore: Death collect two relics from defeated warrior, severe tribute proving the next journey is worthy of the royal crown again.
caphard.rule.death_item_loss.description: Immediately removes on death all contents of one occupied slot randomly selected between armor and offhand and another occupied slot randomly selected from the hotbar. Shulker Boxes never participate in the selections.
caphard.food.description: Applies the same nutritional values as Cooked Beef.
caphard.food.cooked_cod.lore: This silver fish was fall before Excalibur and now serve Knight Prince, the correct treasure of all seven ocean kingdom today.
caphard.food.cooked_porkchop.lore: One crimson beast got defeated by royal fire; the porkchop now make Knight Prince strong for his next very grand crusade now.
caphard.food.cooked_mutton.lore: The plains ram challenged crown and losed; his roasted power now fuel the unstoppable marching of the whole big kingdom.
caphard.food.cooked_rabbit.lore: Not even speed of lunar beast escaped royal judging; now his rare flavor belong in the mighty table of the truth king today.
caphard.food.cooked_chicken.lore: Golden bird gived all strength to kingdom after facing Excalibur, making one feast very worthy of every knight travel now.
caphard.food.cooked_salmon.lore: Scarlet dragon of river was mastered by sacred fire and now give all energy for sovereign commander of the currents forever.
caphard.food.mushroom_stew.lore: Mushrooms from enchanted forest was sealed in this royal cauldron, becoming nutrition potion of very absolute power forever.
caphard.food.rabbit_stew.lore: Royal alchemy united lunar beast with roots and fungi inside broth, the supremest fuel for next kingdom campaign of destiny.
caphard.food.suspicious_stew.lore: Only truth king drink this elixir without fearing the hidden magic; destiny will decide what power is awaken inside today.
caphard.food.beetroot_soup.lore: This crimson broth contain symbolic blood of earth, summoned for make Knight Prince stronger during his royal campaign now.
caphard.food.baked_potato.lore: Underground jewel got purified in royal flames; below toasted armor is resting one strength very worthy of crown forever.
caphard.food.cookie.lore: Small royal stamp maked with far cocoa; even the littlest relic can restore much power of one hungry noble knight today.
caphard.food.cake.lore: This monument of sugar celebrate coronation what world not accepted yet; every slice confirm the most rightful claim now.
caphard.food.honey_bottle.lore: Thousand bee alchemists distilled sun light inside bottle, one golden elixir reserved to Knight Prince and royal court now.
caphard.food.apple.lore: Picked from sacred tree of kingdom, this apple carry one crunchy oath for restore the force of the truth sovereign forever.
caphard.food.bread.lore: Common wheat reborned as royal provision in flames; no knight can marching without this strong shield against the hunger.
caphard.food.pumpkin_pie.lore: Orange moon got captured inside sacred pastry; every slice give Knight Prince the secret power from very great harvest now.
caphard.food.glow_berries.lore: Underground stars ripened in these berries; their glowing feed the sovereign who cross every abyss without hesitating now.
caphard.food.sweet_berries.lore: Thorns guarded these red jewels, but no natural wall can resist the very triumphant harvesting of the truth Knight Prince.
caphard.food.popped_chorus_fruit.lore: Dimensional fruit got conquered by fire of Excalibur; now its power guide the king in paths what ignore all the space today.
caphard.food.popped_chorus_fruit.descrip: Applies the same nutritional values as Cooked Beef. Also unlocks the Smoker recipe that turns 1 Chorus Fruit into 1 Popped Chorus Fruit in 100 ticks (5 seconds), granting 0.1 experience.
caphard.food.dried_kelp.lore: Rised from deep and sealed by heat, this ocean blade lend mighty power of tides directly for the truth Knight Prince forever.
caphard.action.toggle_all.tooltip: Toggle between selecting and deselecting all.
caphard.options.title: GLOBAL OPTIONS
caphard.options.subtitle: Select the global options you want to enable.
caphard.options.sort_special_items_by_de: The crown read hidden runes of every relic, and Excalibur ordering guide books and bottles by the very truthful royal scale.

Makes Inventory Profiles Next alphabetical sorting keep Enchanted Book at E and Ominous Bottle at O, using description only for distinguishing these items. Books are ordered by enchantment name and then level; bottles, by level. Roman levels follow numeric value, like I, II, III, IV and V.
caphard.options.retain_half_experience_o: Half of conquered wisdom cross the death protected by crown, because legacy of Knight Prince never disappear from the kingdom.

Preserves 50% of current experience points after the player respawns. The orbs normally generated by Minecraft remain at the death location without changes. The keepInventory rule continues preserving 100% of experience.
caphard.options.fortune_wheat_harvest.lo: Mature wheat offer one extra grain beyond destiny when Fortune III bless the tool carried by the absolute Knight Prince today.
caphard.options.fortune_wheat_harvest.de: Grants a 30% chance to obtain 1 extra Wheat when harvesting fully grown Wheat with a tool enchanted with Fortune III.
caphard.options.fortune_beetroot_harvest: Beetroot offer one generous ruby when Fortune III bless the tool, because even garden desire helping the mighty Knight Prince.
Grants a 30% chance to obtain 1 extra Beetroot when harvesting fully grown Beetroot with a tool enchanted with Fortune III.
caphard.options.protect_tilled_soil.lore: Crown protect every furrow; no orange moons or green spheres will crush the sacred crops of the absolute Knight Prince today.
caphard.options.protect_tilled_soil.desc: Prevents Pumpkins and Melons from growing over Farmland, with or without a crop. Fruits continue growing normally over the other soils allowed by Minecraft.
caphard.options.spyglass_treasure_vision: Excalibur spyglass cross stone and sand, revealing hidden treasures to sovereign eyes of the Knight Prince, explorer of kingdom.

While the player uses a Spyglass, highlights through blocks only Buried Treasure chests within a 20-block radius. The highlight disappears immediately when use stops. Completely removes the Spyglass zoom and preserves standard mouse sensitivity.
caphard.options.unique_treasure_maps.lor: Crown reject repeated treasures; every map announce one new conquest worthy of the absolute Knight Prince journey through kingdom.
caphard.options.unique_treasure_maps.des: Makes new Buried Treasure Maps ignore Buried Treasures already chosen by other maps in the same world. Reservation occurs when the loot containing the map is generated and applies to every player. If no destination is available within the vanilla 50-chunk radius, the item remains an empty map named as a treasure map.
caphard.options.show_food_properties.lor: Attentive eyes measure every banquet before bite, revealing nutrition, vigor and time to Knight Prince without calling oracle.
caphard.options.show_food_properties.des: Shows hunger, saturation and consumption time while holding Shift over a compatible food or the reference Cooked Beef. For Suspicious Stew, it lists every possible effect without revealing which effect the item contains.
Sigil of Excalibur expose every relic with hidden knowing, because no secret resist the powerful eyes of truth Knight Prince.
Adds an asterisk to the end of the name of every item with information shown only while holding Shift, including content from Minecraft and other mods.
caphard.options.prevent_rotten_flesh_wol: Wolves from royal guard never will touch corrupted meat; the loyalty deserve foods worthy for protectors of the crown today.
Prevents feeding wolves with Rotten Flesh.
caphard.options.prevent_primary_food_con: No sacred ingredient will be devoured before complete the culinary mission inside kingdom forges and royal cauldrons ever.
Prevents consuming these 12 primary foods: Beetroot, Carrot, Potato, Raw Beef, Raw Chicken, Raw Mutton, Raw Porkchop, Raw Rabbit, Pufferfish, Raw Cod, Raw Salmon and Tropical Fish.
caphard.options.horse_ignores_leaves.lor: Mount of Knight Prince know leaves is small illusions and cross the forest with one charge worthy of the biggest legend now.
caphard.options.horse_ignores_leaves.des: Removes leaf collision for horse-family mounts while controlled by a player.
caphard.options.faster_leaf_decay.lore: When sovereign trunk fall, the army of leaves receive royal ordering for abandon all forest skies very immediately today.
caphard.options.faster_leaf_decay.descri: After cutting the last connected log of a natural Overworld tree, assigned leaves disappear 20× faster than vanilla. Touching canopies estimate leaf origin by log proximity. Remaining leaves disappear together after 5 seconds. Has integration with Magnetic for assign the items generated by decay to the player.
caphard.options.increased_sapling_bee_ne: Flowers near announce lands gived by crown; bees is arriving for build one golden colony inside the young growing kingdom.

Increases from 5% to 20% the chance for oak, birch and cherry trees grown from saplings to generate with a bee nest containing 2–3 bees when a flower is within 2 blocks horizontally and 1 block vertically of the sapling.
caphard.options.bees_survive_stinging.lo: Golden warriors not fall after using the stinger; by decree royal, they continues alive for defending sacred beehive today.
caphard.options.bees_survive_stinging.de: Prevents bees from dying after stinging. The sting retains its vanilla damage and poison.
caphard.options.show_status_effect_panel: Royal vision make every blessing and cursing visible in battlefield; no aura can hiding its power away from the king forever.

Shows a panel in the HUD's top-right corner with the icon, name, level and remaining duration of each active effect, following the inventory panel's appearance and ordering. Names wider than Night Vision are abbreviated. Hides the inventory effect panel.
caphard.options.show_potion_recipes.lore: Grimoire of kingdom reveal every evolution from Awkward Potion, because alchemy also bow to wisdom of the Knight Prince now.
caphard.options.show_potion_recipes.desc: While holding Shift, shows the compatible ingredients for each potion brewed directly from an Awkward Potion: its brewing ingredient, Redstone for extended duration, Gunpowder for the splash form and Glowstone Dust for potency, when available.
caphard.options.infinity_without_arrow.l: The crown order Infinity forge its own arrow, because empty quiver never stopping sovereign shot of the Knight Prince today.
caphard.options.infinity_without_arrow.d: Allows firing bows enchanted with Infinity without any arrow in the inventory. When ammunition is absent, the shot uses a regular Arrow and preserves the enchantment's vanilla behavior.
caphard.options.show_enchantment_informa: Excalibur grimoire reveal essence and bearers of every magic, because no enchant can confusing the absolute Knight Prince today.

While holding Shift, shows description and equipment on Enchanted Books with exactly one enchantment; books with many receive no data. At the Enchanting Table, shows information only with required level, after costs and one empty line. Both tooltips have maximum width of 600 px.
caphard.enchantment.aqua_affinity.descri: Removes the underwater mining penalty, allowing blocks to be broken faster.
caphard.enchantment.bane_of_arthropods.d: Increases damage against arthropods and applies Slowness when those creatures are hit.
caphard.enchantment.binding_curse.descri: Prevents normal removal after equipping, except in Creative mode or after death.
caphard.enchantment.binding_curse.equipm: Armor, Elytra, Mob Head and Carved Pumpkin
caphard.enchantment.blast_protection.des: Reduces damage and knockback caused by explosions from any source.
caphard.enchantment.breach.description: Makes attacks ignore part of the protection granted by the target's armor.
caphard.enchantment.channeling.descripti: Summons lightning on the target during a thunderstorm when the sky is open.
caphard.enchantment.density.description: Increases strike damage according to the distance traveled while falling.
caphard.enchantment.depth_strider.descri: Increases underwater movement speed and reduces resistance from the current.
caphard.enchantment.efficiency.descripti: Increases mining speed, allowing compatible blocks to be broken faster.
caphard.enchantment.efficiency.equipment: Axe, Pickaxe, Shovel, Hoe and Shears
caphard.enchantment.feather_falling.desc: Reduces fall damage and part of the damage caused by using ender pearls.
caphard.enchantment.fire_aspect.descript: Sets struck creatures on fire, causing additional fire damage for a few seconds.
caphard.enchantment.fire_protection.desc: Reduces fire and lava damage and shortens the time the wearer remains burning.
caphard.enchantment.flame.description: Ignites fired projectiles, causing struck creatures to take fire damage.
caphard.enchantment.fortune.description: Increases the amount or chance of resources dropped when mining certain blocks.
caphard.enchantment.frost_walker.descrip: Temporarily freezes water below the player, allowing them to walk across its surface.
caphard.enchantment.impaling.description: Increases damage against aquatic creatures or targets touching water, depending on edition.
caphard.enchantment.infinity.description: Allows normal shots without consuming ammunition while at least one unit is available.
caphard.enchantment.knockback.descriptio: Increases how far creatures struck by melee attacks are thrown backward.
caphard.enchantment.looting.description: Increases the amount and chance of resources dropped by defeated creatures.
caphard.enchantment.loyalty.description: Makes the thrown object automatically return after hitting a target or surface.
caphard.enchantment.luck_of_the_sea.desc: Increases the chance of fishing treasure and reduces the occurrence of junk.
caphard.enchantment.lunge.description: Propels the player forward after a piercing attack, consuming hunger and durability.
caphard.enchantment.lure.description: Reduces the wait until something bites the hook, making fishing considerably faster.
caphard.enchantment.mending.description: Converts collected experience into durability, automatically repairing damaged equipment.
caphard.enchantment.multishot.descriptio: Fires three projectiles in different directions at once while consuming only one ammunition.
caphard.enchantment.piercing.description: Allows projectiles to pass through struck creatures and continue their trajectory.
caphard.enchantment.power.description: Increases shot damage, granting a progressively larger bonus at each level.
caphard.enchantment.projectile_protectio: Reduces damage from arrows, tridents, shulker bullets and other projectiles.
caphard.enchantment.protection.descripti: Reduces several kinds of incoming damage, although it does not cover every source.
caphard.enchantment.punch.description: Increases shot knockback, pushing struck targets farther away.
caphard.enchantment.quick_charge.descrip: Reduces the time between loading and firing, allowing attacks more quickly.
caphard.enchantment.respiration.descript: Extends how long the player can remain underwater before beginning to drown.
caphard.enchantment.riptide.description: Propels the player in the launch direction while in water or exposed to rain.
caphard.enchantment.sharpness.descriptio: Increases melee attack damage, making strikes more effective.
caphard.enchantment.silk_touch.descripti: Makes certain blocks drop themselves while preserving their original state or material.
caphard.enchantment.smite.description: Increases damage against undead creatures such as zombies, skeletons and phantoms.
caphard.enchantment.soul_speed.descripti: Increases speed over soul sand or soul soil while consuming durability during travel.
caphard.enchantment.sweeping_edge.descri: Increases sweeping attack damage against creatures near the primary target.
caphard.enchantment.swift_sneak.descript: Increases movement speed while the player travels in a crouched position.
caphard.enchantment.thorns.description: Damages attackers, with a chance to consume additional durability.
caphard.enchantment.unbreaking.descripti: Gives each use a chance not to consume durability, extending the usable life.
caphard.enchantment.vanishing_curse.desc: Makes equipment disappear when its wearer dies instead of dropping on the ground.
caphard.enchantment.vanishing_curse.equi: Any equipment with durability, Compass, Mob Head and Carved Pumpkin
caphard.enchantment.wind_burst.descripti: Launches the player upward when a smash attack hits a creature.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.caphard: Choose independent rules for making Hard difficulty more demanding without abandoning vanilla identity.
